title: A coord.py wait authenticated before its operator's key file is removed still returns the next event to that operator
goal: SP-rsmmwzr2 review G6 (ST-rk5ks4pf): the docs say removing a key file revokes the operator at once, but authenticate runs only at request start, so a long-poll already in flight (no server cap, gate g3) returns the next event to the revoked operator. The server checks the token again before a wait replies (or in its poll loop) and refuses a revoked one with 401.

run:
import json,os,socket,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
T='_tools/coord.py'
D=tempfile.mkdtemp()
E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.db'))
def c(*a,t=30):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=t);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
keys=os.path.join(D,'ops');os.mkdir(keys)
for n in ('alice','bob'):
    open(os.path.join(keys,n),'w').write(n[0]*40);open(os.path.join(D,n+'.key'),'w').write(n[0]*40)
srv=s.Popen([sys.executable,T,'serve','--bind','0','--keys',keys],stdout=s.PIPE,stderr=s.STDOUT,text=True,env=E)
url=srv.stdout.readline().split()[-1].strip().rstrip('/')
hp=url.split('//')[1];host,port=hp.rsplit(':',1);port=int(port)
try:
    w=s.Popen([sys.executable,T,'--url',url,'--key-file',os.path.join(D,'alice.key'),'wait','--since','0','--timeout','8'],stdout=s.PIPE,stderr=s.STDOUT,text=True)
    time.sleep(1.5);os.remove(os.path.join(keys,'alice'))
    s.run([sys.executable,T,'--url',url,'--key-file',os.path.join(D,'bob.key'),'post','--kind','heartbeat','--field','item=ST-bbbbbbbb'],capture_output=True,timeout=30)
    out=w.communicate(timeout=30)[0]
    print('revoked waiter got:',out.strip()[:200])
finally:
    srv.terminate();srv.wait(10)
sys.exit(0 if 'ST-bbbbbbbb' not in out else 1)
